text: {"name":"clear_sta_slot_and_update_cursors","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Clears the selected station-slot marker and reselects any matching cursor from the first marked slot in its range, or clears the cursor if none remain.","subsystem":"mm","var_renames":{"result":"sta_ctx","a2":"sta_idx","v2":"cursor","v4":"candidate_ptr"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":480,"meaning":"Start of six 120-byte station slots."},{"offset":579,"meaning":"Marker byte at offset +99 within the first slot; the same field repeats at a 120-byte stride."},{"offset":1200,"meaning":"Cursor for the first four slots."},{"offset":1204,"meaning":"Cursor for the last two slots."}]}
